title: Binance Futures Will Launch USDⓈ-M POLYX and GAS Perpetual Contracts With Up to 50x Leverage
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures will launch the USDⓈ-M POLYX and GAS Perpetual Contracts at  2023-10-25 02:30 (UTC) and 2023-10-25 02:45 (UTC)  respectively,   with up to 50x leverage.  More details on the USDⓈ-M POLYX and GAS Perpetual Contracts can be found in the table below:   USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contract POLYXUSDT GASUSDT Launch Time  2023-10-25 02:30 (UTC)  2023-10-25 02:45 (UTC)  Underlying Asset POLYX GAS Settlement Asset USDT USDT Tick Size 0.0001 0.001 Capped Funding Rate +2.00% / -2.00% +2.00% / -2.00% Funding Fee Settlement Frequency Every Four Hours Every Four Hours Maximum Leverage 50x 50x Trading Hours 24/7 24/7 Multi-Assets Mode Supported Supported Please Note:  The maximum funding rate of the POLYXUSDT and GASUSDT Perpetual Contracts at the time of launch are +2.00% / -2.00%.  The funding fee settlement frequency is  every four hours . Time Max Funding Rate 2023-10-25 04:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2023-10-25 08:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2023-10-25 12:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% 2023-10-25 16:00 (UTC) +2.00% / -2.00% … … Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the POLYXUSDT and GASUSDT Perpetual Contracts from time to time, which include the funding fee, tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. Multi-Assets Mode  allows users to trade the POLYXUSDT and GASUSDT Perpetual Contracts across multiple margin assets, subject to the applicable haircuts. For example, when the Multi-Assets Mode is activated, users can use BTC as margin when trading the POLYXUSDT and GASUSDT Perpetual Contracts.  The POLYXUSDT and GASUSDT Perpetual Contracts are subject to the terms of the  Binance Terms of Use  and the  Binance Futures Service Agreement .
